name: Single-delivery standards waivers, derived reviewer not-applicable tally, and context-pinned Checked-against sign-offs
summary: Person rule owners and coordinators independent of the contribution author's and task assignee's party can grant single-delivery waivers bound to (task_id, contribution_id, commit), optionally bounded by an UTC expiry date, which expire immediately on any new contribution or commit. Per-reviewer must not_applicable counts are derived on read from committed sign-offs without double-counting on retries. Every approval in a project with a standards register stages a context-pinned sign-off before the native approve comment and crash-recovers by operation_id, exposing Checked against standards register v<N> (never certified or guaranteed) on the task page, JSON/Markdown HTTP endpoints, and CLI standards sign-off export, alongside backup/restore support (--without-standards).
